arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse
from datetime import timezone, timedelta

# Test ti with various timezone formats
r = parse.parse('{:ti}', '2023-01-15T10:30:45Z')
print('Z timezone:', r)

r = parse.parse('{:ti}', '2023-01-15T10:30:45+05:30')
print('+HH:MM timezone:', r)

r = parse.parse('{:ti}', '2023-01-15T10:30:45+0530')
print('+HHMM timezone:', r)

# Test tt type with flexible timezone
r = parse.parse('{:tt}', '10:21:36 PM -5:30')
print('tt with -5:30:', r)

r = parse.parse('{:tt}', '10:21:36 PM -530')
print('tt with -530:', r)
"
